'''Chopper's''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] repair shop located within [[Quadrant L-42]], in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was run by [[Cho'pa'ailor]], a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] nicknamed Chopper, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Many [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] worked in this establishment.
